_note: Hand-checked fixes for HRSA names that CMS lists differently (renames, mergers) and programs known to have closed. Key = the center name exactly as HRSA lists it. alias = the name CMS uses; closed = leave the program out of the directory. cms_id = a CMS facility id chosen by hand because it is the same hospital or campus (same street address, or the same hospital under its current name); the main line of that record is used.
